summaryZh: Leslie Crews Laboratory研究癌症干细胞在多发性骨髓瘤进展、耐药与复发中的作用，重点关注炎症响应通路和骨髓微环境。实验室开发面向骨髓瘤干细胞的RNA检测工具，并测试调节干细胞通路的靶向策略。
researchQuestions: 炎症响应通路如何促进骨髓瘤的干细胞样行为及复发？
topics: 多发性骨髓瘤癌症干细胞
methods: 靶向干细胞通路的治疗策略测试

evidence.quote: our research at UC San Diego towards curative therapies for multiple myeloma!
The ongoing research in the Crews Lab aims to investigate the function of cancer stem cells in multiple myeloma progression and relapse.
Dr. Crews is also pioneering novel myeloma stem cell-targeted RNA detection tools
we are testing novel targeted therapeutics to modulate these vital stem cell regulatory pathways.
